conventional_teg.energy_source: pre-existing waste heat at hot_k; heat sink at cold_k
conventional_teg.model_scope: scenario arithmetic; not a manufacturer rating

evidence_policy: No local numerical scenario receives independent-evidence weight without a measured source-to-load balance

example_module_requirement.module_topology: parallel; thermal input sums across modules
example_module_requirement.purpose: illustrative target sizing, not independent evidence

families.dimension_check: energy_per_cycle_j times frequency_hz has units of W; G is dimensionless but unmeasured
families.empirical_status: no calorimetric source measurement; shared assumptions do not count as evidence
families.reason: legacy G is an unmeasured multiplier; no external heat/work boundary
families.salvage: electrically driven TEC calorimetry with hot/cold reservoirs and a no-gain control

families.dimension_check: field energy is J and turnover rate is Hz; output cannot exceed measured electrical/mechanical drive
families.empirical_status: coil, switching and recharge losses are not independently metered
families.reason: cycling field energy and pump work are not a net source
families.salvage: low-voltage magnetometry and a complete field-energy input/output ledger

families.dimension_check: voltage times current is W only after charge, chemical and mass flux are measured
families.empirical_status: CISS/polarization multipliers are assumptions, not independent measurements
families.reason: evaporation/chemical input and CISS multipliers are unclosed
families.salvage: sealed evaporation/materials test with chemical, mass and electrical calorimetry

families.dimension_check: reported RF power must follow calibrated coupling, Q, bandwidth and temperature units
families.empirical_status: static geometry/calibration tables do not establish a theta signal
families.predicted_signal_vs_noise: expected receiver signal is below conventional thermal/electronics noise until blinded injection and recovery succeed
families.reason: prospective signal channel, not an energy source
families.salvage: blind haloscope/null experiment with measured Q, loss tangent, Tsys and synthetic-tone recovery

families.dimension_check: dimensionless couplings cannot be divided by SI G*m^2 without a consistent natural-unit conversion
families.empirical_status: no force/torque anomaly survives magnetic, species and reversal controls
families.predicted_signal_vs_noise: corrected force/torque estimate is below conventional magnetic and torsion systematics
families.reason: dimensionally inconsistent force ratio and unsupported coupling; ordinary matter channel is null
families.salvage: species-ratio comagnetometer or torsion null measurement with blind sign reversal

families.dimension_check: bit rate, field, torque and power must use measured bandwidth and SI units
families.empirical_status: predicted anomaly is not separated from ordinary magnetic pickup, vibration or thermal drift
families.predicted_signal_vs_noise: conventional field/torque backgrounds exceed the putative signal by many orders until cancellation is demonstrated
families.reason: high-speed magnetic/theta link is bandwidth- and drive-limited; shared motion drives the background
families.salvage: phase detector/comagnetometer with ±source reversal, independent field monitor and preregistered threshold

families.dimension_check: heat flow in W times bounded efficiency gives gross electrical W; all auxiliaries are subtracted
families.empirical_status: manufacturer-rated generator performance and contacts are not supplied
families.reason: local arithmetic is unmeasured model output; accept only after measured hot-side heat, cold sink and parasitics
families.salvage: calibrated waste-heat TEG, calorimetry and zero/reversed-gradient controls

legacy_peltier.energy_source: none_declared; G is not accepted as a source
legacy_peltier.loss_semantics: no_gain_loss_floor is output-independent; diode terms are retained separately because the legacy expression scales with claimed output

literature_context.note: Primary-literature context only: a research module reported about 6.5--7.0% at a temperature difference near 250 K; this is not a rating or validation of the local TEC1-12706 model.
literature_context.title: Towards tellurium-free thermoelectric modules for power generation from low-grade heat

sensitivity.selection_rule: Cartesian parameter grid; no row was fitted to a target output
